speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Waa1, ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 hou2 leng3 aa3!/

speaker: 店員
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Hai6 aa3, ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 san1 fun2./

speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Hou2 ci5 hou2 hou2 sik6 gam2, gei2 cin2 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Ni1 go3 jat1 baak3 baat3 sap6 man1./

speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Jau5 di1 gwai3 wo3, zik6 m4 zik6 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Hou2 zik6 aa3! Jung6 zo2 hou2 do1 coi4 liu2./

speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Jau5 di1 me1 coi4 liu2 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_cantonese: 有新鮮士多啤梨,仲有忌廉同朱古力。
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Jau5 san1 sin1 si6 do1 be1 lei2, zung6 jau5 gei6 lim4 tung4 zyu1 gu2 lik1./

speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Si6 do1 be1 lei2 san1 sin1 gaa3 me1?/

speaker: 店員
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: San1 sin1 aa3! Gam1 ziu1 sin1 dou3 gaa3./

speaker: 阿珊
source_cantonese: 咁呢個值啦!你哋仲有冇其他款式呀?
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Gam2 ni1 go3 zik6 laa1! Nei5 dei6 zung6 jau5 mou5 kei4 taa1 fun2 sik1 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Jau5 aa3, nei5 soeng2 tai2 me1 daan6 gou1 aa3?/

speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Jau5 mou5 mong1 gwo2 daan6 gou1 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Jau5 aa3, go2 go3 hai6 mong1 gwo2 daan6 gou1./

speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Go2 go3 gei2 cin2 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Go2 go3 peng4 di1, jat1 baak3 ji6 sap6 man1./

speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Dim2 gaai2 peng4 zo2 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_cantonese: 因為佢細個啲,用嘅材料都少啲。
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Jan1 wai6 keoi5 sai3 go3 di1, jung6 ge3 coi4 liu2 dou1 siu2 di1./

speaker: 阿珊
source_cantonese: 明白喇。呢兩個邊個好食啲呀?
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Ming4 baak6 laa3. Ni1 loeng5 go3 bin1 go3 hou2 sik6 di1 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_cantonese: 兩個都好好食,不過士多啤梨個更加受歡迎。
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Loeng5 go3 dou1 hou2 hou2 sik6, bat1 gwo3 si6 do1 be1 lei2 go3 gang3 gaa1 sau6 fun1 jing4./

speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Dim2 gaai2 gam3 sau6 fun1 jing4 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_cantonese: 因為啲忌廉唔會太甜,好啱味。
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Jan1 wai6 di1 gei6 lim4 m4 wui5 taai3 tim4, hou2 ngaam1 mei6./

speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Gam2 ngo5 maai5 si6 do1 be1 lei2 go3 laa1!/

speaker: 店員
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Hou2 aa3! Nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 se2 je5 aa3?/

speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Se2 je5? Me1 ji3 si1 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_cantonese: 即係喺蛋糕上面寫生日快樂之類。
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Zik1 hai6 hai2 daan6 gou1 soeng6 min6 se2 saang1 jat6 faai3 lok6 zi1 leoi6./

speaker: 阿珊
source_cantonese: 哦!要呀!寫「生日快樂」,得唔得呀?
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: O4! Jiu3 aa3! Se2 "saang1 jat6 faai3 lok6", dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_cantonese: 得呀,冇問題。要幾多支蠟燭呀?
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Dak1 aa3, mou5 man6 tai4. Jiu3 gei2 do1 zi1 laap6 zuk1 aa3?/

speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Jiu3 ng5 zi1, dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_cantonese: 得呀!我哋送埋蠟燭畀你。
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Dak1 aa3! Ngo5 dei6 sung3 maai4 laap6 zuk1 bei2 nei5./

speaker: 阿珊
source_cantonese: 多謝!你哋服務真係好好!
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Do1 ze6! Nei5 dei6 fuk6 mou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2!/

speaker: 店員
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: M4 sai2 haak3 hei3! Gei2 si4 jiu3 aa3?/

speaker: 阿珊
source_cantonese: 聽日下晝三點鐘得唔得呀?
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Ting1 jat6 haa6 zau3 saam1 dim2 zung1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Dak1 aa3, nei5 lai4 lo2 zau6 dak1 laa3./

speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Hou2 aa3! Jiu3 m4 jiu3 bei2 ding6 gam1 aa3?/

speaker: 店員
source_cantonese: 唔使訂金,你嚟到畀錢就得喇。
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: M4 sai2 ding6 gam1, nei5 lai4 dou3 bei2 cin2 zau6 dak1 laa3./

speaker: 阿珊
source_jyutping: /Aa3 Saan1: Hou2 aa3, do1 ze6 saai3! Ting1 jat6 gin3!/

speaker: 店員
source_jyutping: /Dim3 Jyun4: Ting1 jat6 gin3! Baai1 baai3!/
